title: Cohomology of Hom from a single supported finite free complex
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U$ an open, and $E,I$ integer-indexed complexes of module sheaves on the localized open site [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Fix integers $k,n$. Suppose $E^i=0$ for every $i\ne k$, and choose an isomorphism $E^k\cong\mathcal O_U^{\oplus r}$ with $r\in\mathbf N$. Then $H^n(\mathcal Hom^\bullet(E,I))\cong\bigoplus_{\mathrm{Fin}(r)}H^{k+n}(I)$ [def-pur-hom-complex]. No boundedness or quasi-coherence of $I$ is required.

source.place: Tag 08I5, finite-free column calculation in the proof; Tag 0A8X, product Hom differential.

proof.text: Use the product-limit projections supplied by homComplex_projections_exists. All factors except source degree k are zero, since internal Hom from zero is zero. Construct the inverse to projection by a product lift with the identity in degree k and zero in the other degrees. The fan uniqueness principle proves both inverse identities. The source differential E.d k (k+1) is zero because E^(k+1) is zero, so the differential formula identifies the three-term Hom complex at n with internal Hom from E^k applied to the three-term target complex at k+n.

Internal Hom from the chosen finite free module is additive and preserves short exact sequences by finiteFreeInternalHomExact. Mathlib Functor.exact_tfae converts this to preservation of homology. Transport homology through the three-term complex isomorphism using homologyIsoSc', ShortComplex.homologyMapIso and mapHomologyIso. Finally precompose with the finite-free identification and use the proved source-library homObjFreeIso and the finite biproduct/coproduct isomorphism. Rank zero is covered by the same finite biproduct calculation.

theorem single_supported_finiteFree_homology_iso
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    (E I : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (k : ℤ) (hE : ∀ i : ℤ, i ≠ k → IsZero (E.X i))
    (r : ℕ) (hfree : E.X k ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin r))) (n : ℤ) :
    Nonempty (((homComplex (R := X.toRingedSpace.sheaf.over U) E I).homology n) ≅
      ∐ (fun _ : ULift.{u} (Fin r) ↦ I.homology (k + n)))
